headline: How to Get Rookey
title: How to Get Rookey in Aniimo | Evolve Helmut at Level 45 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Rookey lives in the Russet Highlands, and you can catch it in the wild. You can also evolve it from Helmut. Raise Helmut to level forty five, then defeat an enemy with counter damage while guarding. You also need to learn the required passive talent first. Rookey is a Breaker, so it suits a team that wants to smash enemy defenses. Which route would you pick? Comment below!
description: Rookey in Aniimo can be caught in the Russet Highlands or evolved from Helmut at level 45 by winning with a counter attack while guarding and learning a passive talent.
